answer: Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the atlas forfeiture reveals up in the ocean totals with the cipher audit listing each retired key. Retiring an identity early forfeits 27% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. An operator that abandons 139 aliases after a single epoch thus destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
